baseline: B1 pure static structure (plan §7.1): no GNN representation, no simulation
b1_definition: mean AUC over ['degree', 'betweenness', 'pagerank'] removal orders (GNN order excluded by definition)

contrast.interpretation_rule: RQ1 may claim the GNN layer adds information only if the AI-vs-traditional contrast differs beyond the size-matching interval that s3 reports (degree attack only). A non-zero delta_full alone is NOT evidence of GNN value: B1 and the full R_struct average over different attack sets (3 vs 4), so state both.
contrast.size_note: AI and traditional subnets differ in size; the only interval that accounts for this is resilience.json bootstrap_auc_diff (degree attack only). No interval is computed here.

AI.rule: descriptors and B1_R must describe one induced subgraph; a mismatch means the two numbers must not be quoted in one sentence

traditional.rule: descriptors and B1_R must describe one induced subgraph; a mismatch means the two numbers must not be quoted in one sentence
